manifest.mechanism: schema-per-tenant + per-tenant role GRANT (physical) + FORCE RLS app.tenant policy (logical) + per-tenant AES-256-GCM, tenant-id AAD (crypto). DEKs are unwrapped and cached in service memory; Vault-Transit per-op decrypt is the production posture (in-RAM plaintext / TEE de-scoped to Phase-2).

boundary.note: content/fact/entity-name/retraction-reason are AES-256-GCM at rest (*_ct). embedding + content_ts + the per-tenant-KEYED dedup/name HMACs + slot/entity_ids are plaintext-DERIVED routing artifacts, and closed_by/curated_by/lane are token-subject AUDIT metadata (actor ids, never content) — all inside the tenant's OWN isolated schema (schema-per-tenant + FORCE RLS + role GRANT), never crossing the tenant boundary; the HMACs are unmatchable without the tenant key. Query-time plaintext in app RAM is de-scoped to Phase-2 TEE.
